verdict.rationale: Namecheap exposes a public XML API at api.namecheap.com with a separate sandbox endpoint. An official Go SDK documents programmatic domain operations: availability check, registration, renewal, registrar lock and TLD listing. An official Terraform provider for DNS records, an HTTPS dynamic-DNS update endpoint and an RDAP service round out programmatic access. Missing for 10: the primary API reference docs (methods, authentication and API-key/IP-whitelist setup) are evidenced only by endpoint error responses rather than reference content, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
